title: Eight Sleep expanding card row
description: A row of tall rounded media cards where one is open and wide (about 1.85× the others) and the rest are narrow. Each has a translucent pill tag top-left, a round + button top-right that turns into × when open, and a white caption over a bottom scrim; the open card also shows its sentence. Widths glide in 0.5s. On phones the cards stack, captions either under the media or over it.
notes: the media frames are dark-scoped so captions stay white over photos under any theme
click + to open a card (the others narrow); × closes it and the row evens out
name: eightsleep-expand-cards

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: which card starts open; -1 for none

props.name: phoneCaption
props.description: phones: caption (title + text) under the media in page colours, or title only over the media

props.name: radius
props.description: corner size: xl (20px) or 2xl (24px) with the default theme
